mathematical_definition: spread_t - spread_{t-1} -- tick-over-tick change in quoted spread, computed from TickActivityTracker's own last-seen spread (not a bar-level diff)
numerical_stability_notes: Stateful: TickActivityTracker keeps only the single last-seen spread value (self._last_spread), not a ring buffer. No division involved, so no blow-up risk. Genuinely new for Task 21 (spec section 7) -- exists only because Phase 2 gave the live engine a real tick stream; the 6.7-year historical CSV has no tick-level spread series to diff, so this feature has no historical analogue and cannot be backfilled.
missing_value_policy: None on the very first tick seen by the tracker (no previous spread to diff against), never zero-filled
status_reason: no historical evidence exists or can exist for this feature; live data only since 2026-08-18 (Phase 2 live verification date)
